app: AI-Weld Settings Library / Vectis Weld Recipe Control
milestone: V2-M1 — Mild Steel Baseline Range Table Structure
purpose: Create a safe data structure for holding mild steel baseline high/low weld setting ranges by weld type without creating proven production recipes.

v1_context.carry_forward_rule: Baseline range = starting reference only. Tested result = what actually happened. Locked recipe = approved production record.
v1_context.required_control_path: Reference Data → Test Coupon → Tested Result → Approval → Locked Recipe

separation_rules.rule: Baseline range rows are reference-only structures and must not be stored as tested results, locked recipes, rejected settings, or superseded settings.
